title: Record the erasure of one unweighted tensor kernel on the P-grid
body:
## Summary
- On the family `p = 2^(10a)`, `m = 2^(4a)`, `X = 2^(3a)`, the unweighted kernel exponent exceeds `P = 32768p`, so toward-zero rounding on that grid is zero.
- The weighted exponent stays strictly below `p/8` for every integer `a` from 26 through 64.
- The scalar band identities hold on all 39 scales, and the selected κ is unchanged.
